name: the-new
description: THE NEW — a 48s deterministic film written in code

scripts.mux: ffmpeg -y -i build/picture.mp4 -i build/score.wav -map 0:v -map 1:a -c:v copy -c:a aac -b:a 256k -ar 48000 -t 48 -movflags +faststart THE_NEW.mp4
scripts.render: npm run score && npm run picture && npm run mux
